question: Check loop invariant proof for the merge routine while loop

proof_submission.statement: Loop invariant for merge(): at each iteration of the while loop, temp[0..k-1] contains the k smallest elements of arr[left..mid] and arr[mid+1..right] in sorted order
proof_submission.initialization: Prior to the first iteration of the loop, k = 0, so temp[0..-1] is empty, which vacuously contains the 0 smallest elements in sorted order.
proof_submission.maintenance: At each iteration, arr[i] and arr[j] are compared. Since arr[left..mid] and arr[mid+1..right] are already sorted, min(arr[i], arr[j]) is the smallest uncopied element and is placed into temp[k]. Incrementing k and the respective index preserves the invariant for k+1.
proof_submission.termination: The loop terminates when i > mid or j > right. At termination, one subarray is exhausted and temp contains all copied elements in sorted order; the subsequent while-loops copy the remaining elements.
